description.text: SICAS "Student Relative Arrival Package"is thecustomization for students' relatives tohelpyou to have a soft and safetravelin China. 1. Airport Pick-up With SICAS "Student Relative Arrival Package",SICAS staff will pick you up at any time, even at mid-night in China, pull the luggage for you.Besides, SICAS willarrange special car to pick you up, most of the time, the drivers are English speakers. 2. Hotel Arrangement According to your budget, after your arrival,SICAS will help you arrange the most comfortable hotel in a safe district near the student's campus. 3. ApartmentRenting If you want to stayin China for a long time, SICAS will rent the most suitable apartmentfor you,help you to check and sign theApartment Renting Agreementbetween you and your Landlord to avoid any renting problems in the future,and make sure all the items will be right within the define of the Law of Chinese Central Government & Local Government. 4. Security Guarantee SICAS offer to"Student Relative Arrival Package"students' relativesa24 hours parents -style care for any urgent issue or accident of SICAS students' relatives. 5. Legal Counselor During your stay in China, if your visa is expired,SICAS will be the legalcounselor tohelp you to extend it. 6. Tourism Service During your stay in China, SICAS will arrange the most experiencedtour guide for youor help you join the touring party, to make sure you have a soft and safetravel in China.
